sentence: Runs a weighted random spin to pick one person in the chat for a chore, giving people with fewer past chores better odds, and lets the picked person accept it to add to their count.
use_when: Someone needs to be picked for a household chore like mopping or taking out trash
The group wants a fair random pick that favors people who have done less
Chat members want to settle who does a task without arguing
A chore needs a pick that the chosen person can accept and have counted
dont_use_when: The group wants a plain even random pick with no history or weights
People need to vote on a choice or options rather than be assigned
The group needs a recurring rotating schedule across many weeks
Only one person is in the chat and there is nobody to pick between
